title: Compliant device policy excludes a large share of users

maxExcludedPct.text: Share of users excluded before the policy stops being general

report.title: {Items.Count} device compliance {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy excludes', 'policies exclude')} more than {params.maxExcludedPct}% of users

messages.businessImpact: Exclusions added for a migration or a pilot tend to outlive their reason, and each one is a population reaching company data from devices nobody is checking.
remediation: Review each exclusion group and remove the members who no longer need it.
Keep emergency access accounts excluded; everything else should be time bound.
messages.cannotSee: How many people the tenant licenses exactly. The share is measured against the largest number of seats consumed on any one subscription, which is the closest a subscription list gets, and an excluded group that would not answer for its membership counts nobody rather than a guess.
